_comment: ONE schema, shared by afx-terminal-agent-launcher.ps1 (Windows) and afx-terminal-agent-launcher.sh (Mac/Linux). This file is a schema example; the real, live allforx-projects.json is machine-local and deliberately NOT committed (paths differ per machine and this file is edited directly by the owner — a committed copy would immediately start drifting from the truth). Copy this to allforx-projects.json next to the launcher on each machine and fill in that machine's real paths.

projects.name: My Tools repo
projects.notes: shared tooling repo, not a product
